adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration derives category_id via `INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'`, which only succeeds when the old `embed_category` setting value exactly equals `categories.name` (string match, case/format sensitive). If it doesn’t match, `category_id` becomes 0 and the migration falls back to `uncategorized_category_id`, and then it deletes the `embed_category` site setting (`DELETE ... IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')`). This can silently drop the intended embed category during migration and change behavior for new embedded topics.
